subject: Clearpath pilot: mutual action plan and cutover windows
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearpath.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood MAP & cutover plan for pilot

Hi Soojin / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Clearpath is excited to move the pilot forward. To keep momentum, can we lock a short mutual action plan (MAP) that lists milestones, owners, and realistic target dates? Key constraints on our side: internal security review windows the week of Dec 13, and our data team will be on leave Dec 24–Jan 2.

High-level asks from our side:
- Staging availability before Dec 21 for validation
- Production soft-launch window in January (flexible)
- A short SLA for the pilot (uptime + response time) we can share with our platform team

Can you propose an execution lane with owners and cutover windows? A single-sheet spreadsheet would be perfect — we can iterate.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Huang
Head of Platform, Clearpath.ai
claire.huang@clearpath.ai
+1 415 555 0198

Attachment: (none yet)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearpath.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & cutover plan for pilot

Claire — thank you, great to hear the team is aligned. I put together a one-page draft MAP and call out two execution lanes (Platform & CS/Integration). Draft highlights below and attached spreadsheet is the editable source.

Draft MAP (high level) — see attached clearpath_MAP_v1.xlsx:
- Milestone: Staging provisioned (owner: Redwood infra / owner: Monica Patel) — target: 2026-12-17
- Milestone: Data ingest & validation (owner: Clearpath data / owner: Claire Huang) — target: 2026-12-20
- Milestone: Pilot validation run (owner: Redwood CS / owner: Ben Carter) — 2026-12-21 to 2026-12-22
- Milestone: Production soft launch (owner: Clearpath ops + Redwood infra) — target: 2027-01-05
- Cutover freeze window: 2026-12-23 to 2027-01-02 (no major changes)

Risks I call out in the sheet: holiday staffing, data schema mismatches, and IAM provisioning delays. I've added an initial risk owner column; Monica will own the risk register.

Next actions:
1) Claire: review dates and owners in the attached sheet and flag anything that needs to move.
2) Monica: I'll hand the infra provisioning plan to you to confirm capacity and windows.
3) Ben: can you prepare the CS validation checklist (test cases + success criteria) by Tue 11/24?

I'll attach the MAP and the risk register now.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Soojin Lee
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: clearpath_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), clearpath_risk_register_v1.csv (csv stub)

From: monica_patel@redwood.com <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearpath.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & cutover plan for pilot

Thanks Soojin — I reviewed the draft and updated the execution lanes in the attached risk register. Key edits I made:
- Shifted infra provisioning checkpoint earlier by 24 hours (now 2026-12-16) to allow a 48-hour buffer before data ingest.
- Added IAM step (owner: Clearpath IT / contact Tom Becker) with a target of 2026-12-10 — provisioning is frequently a blocker.
- Added contingency path if the data team needs to push validation into Jan (minimal impact to soft-launch if we stagger tests).

Ben — can you confirm the validation checklist items you expect to cover? I added a placeholder list in the sheet but would like your final scope.

Monica Patel
Sr. Platform Engineer, Redwood Dedicated
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: clearpath_risk_register_v1.csv

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearpath.ai>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, Tom Becker <tbecker@clearpath.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & cutover plan for pilot

Thanks — this looks good and I appreciate the contingency lanes. Quick update from our side: our security review now lands the week of Dec 20 (shifted one week later), which may push our data validation target to Dec 23. We want staging for validation to remain available by Dec 22 if possible.

Tom is on this thread for IAM — Tom, can you confirm target for role provisioning (Monica set 12/10)? If that's tight, we can escalate to our IT lead.

Otherwise we like the owners and the validation checklist outline — Ben, any concerns with the proposed dates? If we need to slide, let's identify the tradeoffs.

On governance: we'll need a short SLA statement for the pilot (uptime objective + support hours) to include in our internal approval packet. If Redwood can provide a one-paragraph SLA, that would help expedite our security sign-off.

— Claire

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearpath.ai>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP & cutover plan for pilot

Claire / team — thanks for the update and for flagging the security timing. Quick read on next steps from CS and delivery:

- Validation checklist: I reviewed Monica's placeholders and added the test-case owners in the sheet (authentication, throughput, latency, sample prompts). I'll upload a finalized checklist by EOD Fri 11/27.
- Staging availability: Monica has confirmed we can provision staging by 2026-12-16 (per her edit). If Clearpath needs an extra day (12/22) for the security review, we can extend test window into Dec 22–23 but prefer not to push past Dec 23.
- SLA paragraph: Draft below for your approval (short + pilot-focused):

  Redwood Pilot SLA (single paragraph): For the duration of the Clearpath pilot, Redwood commits to 99.0% availability for the provisioned pilot environment during business hours (Mon–Fri, 7am–7pm PT). Redwood will respond to P1 pilot incidents within 30 minutes and P2 incidents within 4 hours. This SLA is intended for approval-tracking purposes only and does not constitute a contract.

If that reads ok, I'll paste the text into a short PDF and upload to the DocuSign link you shared.

Finally, I'll create the HubSpot playbook entry and link it to the MAP (HubSpot id in links).

Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: (updates committed to the shared spreadsheet)
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/clearpath/record/CP-4821, DocuSign draft https://app.docusign.com/documents/3914820
